title: Model pricing (ai.platform/v1)
description: Explicit, inspectable prices used only to ESTIMATE cost in telemetry. Estimates are not billing. Pricing lives outside capability.yaml because prices are deployment/provider facts, not part of the capability contract.
$comment: A released version of this schema must not be mutated.

currency.description: ISO-4217-SHAPED code (three uppercase letters). The schema does not verify that the code is a real currency.

prices.description: An empty list means no prices: cost is reported as unknown, never as zero.

price.description: Applies only on an exact match of adapter name and adapter-reported model label.

decimalString.description: Currency units per 1,000,000 tokens, as a quoted decimal string (never a YAML float).
